# Orcha Digital

Orcha Digital is a digital marketing and creative agency based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
Tagline: Ideas | Content | Growth. Headline: Your Digital Growth Partner.

## What the agency offers

- Social Media Management
- Graphic Design
- Video Editing
- Social Media Advertising
- Social Media Strategy
- Website / Landing Page design
- SEO & Google Marketing
- Branding & Identity
- Content Writing

Monthly social media management packages (Starter, Growth, Premium) are available, and custom packages can be created on request. The agency follows a four-step process: Plan, Create, Publish, Grow.

## Portfolio note

The portfolio on the site consists of in-house concept projects created to demonstrate style and capability. They are labelled as concept work and are not client projects.
